Name: Bloodwing Nocturne
Desc4: The equipper's CRIT DMG increases by 30%, and Daze dealt by attacks increases by 5%. If the equipper is a Stun character, using an EX Special Attack or Chain Attack while their CRIT Rate is greater than or equal to 50% increases all squad members' Sharp DMG dealt by 8% for 25s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
